text:
maria: incident-bot fired: PagerDuty -> SEV2: inference-api-prod high 5xx rate (HTTP 502/504). Link: https://pd/redwood/alerts/INC-1755 :pagerduty:
opsbot: automated alert: 5xx rate 3.4% (baseline 0.02%) across us-west1. Runbook: https://runbook.redwood/5xx-spike
sam: acked. I'm oncall. what's the customer impact? :hand:
arjun: customers hitting chat streaming endpoints seeing failures, retries causing user-visible timeouts. Early metric: 12% of requests in last 2m had 502. Possibly upstream auth-proxy.
jess: seeing spike in auth-proxy 502s from rate-limited token-introspect. Logs:
```
auth-proxy: upstream 502 "context deadline exceeded" x-request-id=abc123
```
maria: paging history shows recent deploy to auth-proxy 10m ago. Can we rollback? sam: hold, let's confirm cluster-level resource pressure first. opsbot: current infra: auth-proxy pods restarting 1m avg, CPU ~70%, mem normal. arjun: check the gateway keepalive/tilt metrics - could be connection saturation. jess: I ran curl to cluster-internal health: `curl -sS -D - http://auth-proxy:8080/health` -> returning 502 intermittently. sam: initiating canary-rollout rollback for auth-proxy to previous revision. jess: started rollout revert: kubectl set image deploy/auth-proxy auth-proxy=redwood/auth-proxy:v1.9.3 --record
opsbot: PagerDuty escalation to on-call secondary scheduled at +5m if no ack from primary — acked by sam. maria: contacting customer-support to surface possible impacts. pagerbot: PD: escalation suppressed (manual ack) :white_check_mark:
arjun: also enabling fallback route for streaming: set route weight inference-gateway->embedding-service 0.2 -> 0.8 fallback. sam: applying routing change now: `./tools/route-adjust --service inference-gateway --fallback auth-variant` sam: rollback started, monitoring logs. 60s: 5xx rate down to 1.1%.
jess: kv-cache eviction rate spiked earlier but stabilized. opsbot: metrics show slow decline in 502s, avg latency still elevated at 220ms. sam: keeping page open until stable for 15m. maria: customer impact note: some webhooks failed, internal retries mitigated many. We'll sync with CS in 10m. arjun: root cause suspected: token introspection endpoint degraded after new token cache logic combined with stricter timeouts in v1.10; rollback to v1.9.3 fixed connection pattern. sam: marking this as mitigated, will file incident and schedule postmortem. jess: filed initial incident (INC-1755555) in tracker. opsbot: runbook step completed: rollback + routing fallback + monitor. pagerbot: PD: resolve triggered by manual resolve command. sam: resolving pager and handoff to morning rotation. maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
